description: This file defines the CompoundTypeAliasTree class, a prefix tree for managing compound type aliases, including adding and retrieving nodes based on keys, and managing children nodes.

classes.name: CompoundTypeAliasTree
classes.description: A prefix tree data structure representing compound type aliases, supporting operations like adding nodes, retrieving children, and maintaining type associations.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new root instance of the CompoundTypeAliasTree with no key or value.

methods.name: GetChildOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a child node associated with the given key, or null if it does not exist.

methods.name: TryGetChild
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a child node with the specified key; returns true if found.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a node with a key (string or Type) and optionally a value (Type).

methods.name: AddInternal
methods.description: Internal method to add a node with a key and optional value, handling existing entries and duplicates.
